question: 2026년 9월 영업일 기준 일별 거래금액 합계를 보여줘
sql:
SELECT f.base_dt, SUM(f.trd_amt) AS trd_amt
FROM dw.trd_day_f f
JOIN dw.cmn_biz_day_d d ON d.base_dt = f.base_dt AND d.biz_day_yn = 'Y'
WHERE f.base_dt BETWEEN :from_dt AND :to_dt
GROUP BY f.base_dt
ORDER BY f.base_dt

question: 기준일 직전 5영업일 동안 지점별 수수료 합계
sql:
SELECT b.brn_nm, SUM(f.fee_amt) AS fee_amt
FROM dw.trd_day_f f
JOIN dw.org_branch_d b ON b.brn_cd = f.brn_cd
JOIN (SELECT base_dt FROM dw.cmn_biz_day_d
      WHERE biz_day_yn = 'Y' AND base_dt < :base_dt
      ORDER BY base_dt DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) d ON d.base_dt = f.base_dt
GROUP BY b.brn_nm
ORDER BY fee_amt DESC
